status: Two original-bytecode-backed source differences repaired and compiled; valid-world runtime acceptance remains open.

source.change_summary: Fixed both direct 0.5625 comparisons and restored g(BlockPos) original d() gate/fallback ordering. The final source tree hash covers all 1,602 Java files.

additional_source_change.change: Restored the original d() gate before null validation and world lookup; d()!=0 returns the centered/top fallback.

confirmed_difference_and_fix.original: At both 0.5625 threshold sites the original compares heightDelta directly to the constant with dcmpl; NaN therefore does not take the greater-than branch.
confirmed_difference_and_fix.pre_fix_source: Subtracting 0.5625 first and translating Kotlin Double.compareTo semantics treated a NaN difference as positive.
confirmed_difference_and_fix.post_fix_compiled: Both sites compile as a direct double comparison against 0.5625D, using dcmpl and the same greater-than branch outcome as the original for NaN and finite values.

bytecode_review.other_difference_not_closed: No additional static mismatch was established in the reviewed route converter and height helper. Valid-world behavior is still untested.

height_helper.finding: Original calls d() before null validation and world lookup. If d()!=0 it returns (x+0.5,y+1,z+0.5); otherwise it reads level and derives top height from snow layers or the voxel shape. Current source and compiled call order now match.

gate_state.initialization: <clinit> sets 104 through b(I)V; b is the only direct putstatic; c()I reads the field; d()I returns 62 only if the field is zero, otherwise 0.
gate_state.normal_internal_writes: The only non-initialization b(I)V call is in a(AABB;DDLnet/minecraft/world/phys/Vec3;D)Ljava/util/List; at offset 589 and requires helper.f()==null. That helper initializes and returns a three-element array; no normal internal route to field value 0 was identified.
gate_state.external_boundary: b(I)V is public; external calls or dynamic reflection may set zero and were not excluded. The original fallback remains restored for that state.
gate_state.other_direct_writes_or_handles: No additional direct field writes or associated MethodHandle were found in the scan.

bytecode_review.exception_path: Original g has five NoWhenBranchMatchedException catch entries whose helper returns the same exception. The current compiled helper rethrow method also returns its input unchanged; no outward exception transformation was identified.

gate_reachability.result: No normal internal path to zero identified; external public setter/reflection remains outside proof.
gate_reachability.source_review: Read-only full-bytecode scan; no source changes were made by the reviewer.

boundary_probe.assertions: Corrected predicate matches dcmpl greater-than semantics on all six fixtures; the previous translation differs for NaN.

nonfatal_output: Fabric Loom reported missing markdown metadata in mod-provided javadoc.

A correctly located build used JAVA_HOME pointing to Java 17; Loom requires Java 25. The unchanged source then built successfully after selecting Temurin 25.0.4.1.
